family_reports.body: The family court has stolen time with my kids memories I can never get back and made someone who worked hard play harder a prisoner not only in my mind but in everyday life. I find myself in my own my own prison not wanting to go anywhere or talk to anyone and can find days become night. Family court has broken me down where I have lost any hope that justice exists.

On false allegations with no evidence, I was reduced from full physical and legal custody to a 15 minute phone call once a month. I have never been adjudicated of doing any harm to anyone and never been allowed to defend myself after numerous false allegations.
I now have two emotionally damaged children and have been barred from helping them. If I had learned to lie, maybe I could have more than 15 minutes a month with my 14 year-old daughter.
